title: Abnormal Involuntary Movement Scale (draft v1, awaiting complete source)
description: The tardive-dyskinesia criteria reference AIMS but do not contain its complete form. No items are invented here. This draft records the gap, the only source-backed research thresholds (Schooler-Kane), and what the owner must supply. Not approved.

administration.note: Administration protocol cannot be drafted until the complete AIMS form/source is identified. Do not administer an invented form.

completeness.rule: Completeness cannot be defined without the complete item set. When the complete source is identified, completeness will be all_required_when_present (full completion only when tardive dyskinesia is present; absent/not_assessed require no completion), with missing suppressing results to null unless the reviewed source defines a missing-data rule.

scoring.no_total_score_diagnosis: AIMS supports measurement; its total score alone does not establish diagnosis or determine intervention.
scoring.schooler_kane_research_thresholds_only: Schooler-Kane probable tardive dyskinesia requires at least 3 months cumulative antipsychotic exposure, no alternative cause, and either moderate movements in one body region or mild movements in two or more. On AIMS these correspond to a regional score of 3 or greater in one region, or 2 or greater in at least two regions. These are research thresholds, not additional DSM requirements.

urgent.note: No AIMS-specific emergency threshold is defined in the source. Urgent concerns ride separately from questionnaire completion.

source.note: Supplied tardive-dyskinesia-criteria.md references AIMS without its complete form. Items, anchors, and administration await the complete source.

assumptions: No AIMS items, anchors, or administration are assumed; inventing them would violate the S12 constraint.
Schooler-Kane thresholds are the only source-backed numeric rule in this draft.
source_gaps: OPEN: identify the complete AIMS source/form (version, item wording, anchors, administration, completeness, scoring) for owner review.
OPEN: review concrete AIMS item/completeness/severity/network definitions once the source is identified.

independent_examples.name: schooler_kane_one_region_moderate
independent_examples.expected: Meets Schooler-Kane research threshold (3+ in one region with exposure and no alternative cause). Research threshold only; not a diagnosis and not an AIMS total.

independent_examples.name: schooler_kane_two_regions_mild
independent_examples.expected: Meets Schooler-Kane research threshold (2+ in at least two regions with exposure and no alternative cause). Research threshold only.

independent_examples.name: below_research_threshold
independent_examples.expected: Does not meet the Schooler-Kane research threshold (needs 3+ in one or 2+ in two).

independent_examples.name: questionnaire_status
independent_examples.expected: status awaiting_source; scores null; completeness undefined until the complete form is reviewed. Present tardive dyskinesia cannot clear questionnaire completion until the source is resolved.

severity_mapping.reviewed_severity: Independent clinician-reviewed severity (mild|moderate|severe) recorded alongside the instrument when status is present; it is NOT inferred from an unreviewed AIMS total. Concrete wording requires owner review alongside the complete form.
severity_mapping.no_diagnosis_from_total: No diagnosis is inferred from an AIMS total.

network_mappings.F1_tardive_dyskinesia: Effect presence plus reviewed severity plus history context (exposure, persistence, onset, regions, functional impact, alternative explanations). AIMS responses are measurement context only, pending the complete source.

mapping_gaps: Complete AIMS form/source, item/completeness/severity/network definitions, and source-required context/missing-input policy require owner review before package use (S33).
Absent versus not_assessed stays distinct; no missing finding maps to No.
